art_direction: 浅鼠尾草底，右低而更开，双眼一同抬望，短暂地惊讶。
composition_variation: Set the right lower but more open, reversing the usual rising diagonal. Both pupils look up together, large and calm; lift the lids just enough to expose extra side color. Keep lower contours rounded and corners soft. Convey attentive brief surprise without circular staring eyes. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
